title: Manager correction
description: Written by the record_correction MCP tool (or the review queue) and processed by the Codex correction worker.

hermes_claim.description: The claim Hermes made that was corrected.

corrected_fact.description: Hermes's one-line restatement of the corrected fact, e.g. 'Camera B door propped by a box from 14:02 to 14:31'.

is_rule.description: True if the manager stated a site rule (also saved as a Hermes skill).

worker_report.description: Path to the worker's markdown report.
